grizzly.summary: An eight-missile air-defense launcher housed in a shipping container, for use against drones, helicopters and low-flying aircraft.
facts: Medium and large drones, helicopters and low, slow aircraft
notes: Close DCS and extract TPG Containerized SHORAD into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/. Check that entry.lua is directly inside the mod folder, then restart DCS.
Find TPG Containerized SHORAD under Air Defence in Mission Editor. Place it on level ground with a clear view of approaching targets. Paint Scheme offers the default, Woodland and Sand finishes.
The launcher must stop to fire. It carries eight missiles, can guide four at a time and fires at ten-second intervals. Reloading takes 18 minutes.

It can detect targets out to 12 km and fire at targets 1.2–9 km away. A target may be detected before it is close enough to engage. Altitude also matters: the 10,000 m targeting limit does not mean the missile can reach a target 10 km overhead.
payloadNotes: Each missile has an anti-aircraft warhead with 15 kg of explosive in DCS and detonates within 15 m of its target. The launcher carries eight ready missiles.

paragraphs: Short-range air-defense systems protect troops and fixed sites from nearby aircraft and drones. Many combine radar and cameras with missiles, guns or electronic countermeasures.
MBDA introduced Sky Warden in 2021 for this role, with equipment that can be carried on a vehicle or set up on the ground. TPG Containerized SHORAD is a custom design with a similar role.

v2.summary: A V-2 with static launch bases and Sd.Kfz. 7 towed launchers, custom ballistic trajectories, and camouflaged or black-and-white finishes.
notes: Close DCS and copy TPG V2 into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/, then restart DCS. Choose a static or Sd.Kfz. 7 towed launcher in either camouflage or black-and-white markings.

Place one launcher per group. At the firing waypoint, stop on clear, level ground and select Advanced Waypoint Actions → Perform Task → Fire at Point. Choose a target 50–300 km away and set expenditure to one round. Each launcher carries one rocket and cannot reload.

For a towed launcher, use Alarm State Green and a waypoint speed above zero to travel. Stop at the firing waypoint and set Alarm State Red to deploy. The supports lower, the rocket rises and the truck pulls the trailer clear. Allow about three minutes for setup, and make sure ROE permits firing.

The rocket follows a custom ballistic trajectory that changes with target distance. The graph below shows flights of about 33, 103 and 162 nautical miles, reaching roughly 85,000, 198,000 and 288,000 ft. On long-range shots it climbs to about 88 km and reaches roughly Mach 3.5 near impact.
Expect individual rockets to miss by several kilometres. This is an area-bombardment weapon. After firing, the AI stows the launcher; use Alarm State Green to pack up for travel.
payloadNotes: In DCS, the V-2 carries a 1,000 kg warhead with 910 kg of explosive and a 90 kg armor-piercing component. It is suited to large area targets.

paragraphs: Germany developed the V-2 as the A4 and first used it in combat in September 1944. A liquid-fuel engine sent it high above the battlefield before it fell toward its target at supersonic speed. London and Antwerp were among its main targets.

The rocket was too inaccurate for precision attacks. It was produced using concentration-camp forced labor at Mittelbau-Dora. After the war, captured V-2s and German engineers helped shape American and Soviet missile and space programs.

12-pounder-cannon.summary: A 12-pounder cannon with iron cannonball and fictional Lavaball versions. Both can engage enemies automatically or be controlled through Combined Arms.
facts: Exposed troops, unarmored vehicles and light structures
notes: Close DCS and copy TPG_12_Pounder_Cannon into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/, then restart DCS. Under Artillery in Mission Editor, choose TPG 12 Pounder Cannon – Cannonball or TPG 12 Pounder Cannon – Lavaball.
The cannon fires automatically at enemies it can detect and reach when ROE and Alarm State allow it. Give it a clear line of sight and keep it stopped while firing.
Each unit carries 20 rounds of its selected ammunition. Firing range is 30 m–2.4 km, with 30 seconds between shots and a ten-minute reload time.
To control the cannon yourself, you need Combined Arms and vehicle-control permission in the mission or server. In multiplayer, both the server and players need the mod.
payloadNotes: The iron cannonball weighs about 5.44 kg (12 lb) and leaves the muzzle at 300 m/s. It has no explosive filling and deals damage through impact.
Lavaball is a fictional glowing round with 0.8 kg of explosive in DCS. It follows the same basic flight path as the cannonball.

paragraphs: A 12-pounder takes its name from the weight of the iron ball it fires. The term was used for many smoothbore gun designs rather than one particular cannon.
Solid iron shot damaged structures and struck troops or vehicles by impact. Historical guns also fired explosive shells and canister. The Lavaball is a fictional addition for DCS.

items: The cannon now fires automatically at enemies it can detect within range. A script hook is no longer required.

apkws-vshorad.summary: A stationary air-defense turret with 16 laser-guided 70 mm rockets, split between launchers for closer and more distant targets.
facts: Drones, helicopters and low, slow aircraft
notes: Copy TPG APKWS VSHORAD into your active Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/ folder, then restart DCS. Keep only one installed copy. Find the unit under Air Defence in Mission Editor and choose its finish with Paint Scheme.

The turret has two banks of eight rockets, set at different launch angles. The NEAR bank covers 1–3 km and the FAR bank covers 3.001–4.5 km. These distances guide ammunition selection: a FAR rocket may intercept a target that has moved closer, while the NEAR bank may wait for an approaching target to enter range.

The turret tracks targets with optical and infrared sensors and guides its rockets by laser. Place it on level ground with a clear line of sight. Terrain, trees and buildings can block the laser or the rocket even when the unit is still tracking the target.

It can turn through 360 degrees and elevate from -30 to +85 degrees. It turns at up to 120 degrees per second and raises or lowers the launcher at up to 90 degrees per second. There is a two-second delay between shots; reloading takes five minutes.
Keep Config.lua in the mod folder and restart DCS after changing its settings.
payloadNotes: Each rocket has an M151-type high-explosive fragmentation warhead with 1.04 kg of explosive in DCS. A laser guides it toward the target. The two launch banks hold eight rockets each.

paragraphs: APKWS turns a standard 70 mm rocket into a guided weapon by adding a laser-guidance section. Originally developed for aircraft, it has since been used on ground and maritime launchers.

L3Harris began testing its VAMPIRE system in 2021 and received a contract in January 2023 to supply it to Ukraine. VAMPIRE pairs a camera and laser designator with guided rockets for use against drones and ground targets. The TPG mod has its own stationary, 16-round turret design.

sahin-cuas.summary: A stationary 40 mm counter-drone gun based on the Mk19, for engaging slow drones and helicopters at close range.
facts: Slow drones and low, slow helicopters at close range
notes: Close DCS and copy TPG_SAHIN_CUAS into your active Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/ folder, then restart DCS.
Use it against slow drones and low, slow helicopters nearby. Give the gun a clear line of sight. It can detect targets out to 10 km, but can only fire at targets within 600 m.
The gun carries 192 rounds in groups of 64 and fires at about 261 rounds per minute. This alpha uses a modified M430 round with a tighter shot pattern.
payloadNotes: The mod uses a modified 40 mm M430 dual-purpose grenade weighing 0.248 kg, with 0.1 kg of explosive and shaped-charge damage in DCS. This alpha relies on direct hits. The real ŞAHİN fires programmable ATOM grenades that burst in the air near the target.

paragraphs: ASELSAN developed ŞAHİN to defend against small drones at close range. It automatically detects and tracks targets, then fires 40 mm programmable ATOM grenades that burst in the air near them.

akinci.summary: An AI-controlled Akıncı-C with nine weapon stations, optical and infrared sensors, and multirole radar.

fps-132.summary: An unarmed radar-site model for mission scenery or use as a ground target.
facts: No active detection in this package
notes: An unarmed static structure with collision geometry for the housing, berm, buildings and plinth.

anduril-rail.summary: A stationary launcher for GPS-guided and anti-ship ALTIUS-700M drones.
notes: Place the launcher with a clear flight path, allowing room for the drone to climb.

fp1-drone.summary: A rail-launched FP1 drone with a booster mounted beneath it.
notes: Allow a clear departure path and plan the route around terrain and obstacles.

shahed-238.summary: Rail-launched, jet-powered Shahed-238 drones in GPS and anti-ship versions, with up to five launches per unit.
notes: Close DCS and extract TPG_Shahed238_Rail into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/. Check that entry.lua is directly inside the mod folder, then restart DCS.

Find TPG Shahed-238 GPS and TPG Shahed-238 ASM under Artillery in Mission Editor. Both launchers stay in place, display one drone on the rail and carry up to five shots. You can reduce ammunition in Mission Editor and choose Original Green or Sand Tan with Paint Scheme.
For the GPS version, select Advanced Waypoint Actions → Perform Task → Fire at Point and choose a ground target. The drone flies to that point.

The ASM version is for attacking ships. Use Fire at Point to send it toward a point at sea. If an enemy ship comes within 8 km and is visible to the seeker ahead of the drone, it turns to attack. If it finds no ship, it continues to the assigned point.
Launch range is 20–1,000 km. The drone cruises at 500 km/h at a height of 300 m. Plan a clear flight path around terrain, trees and buildings. Allow ten minutes between launches and for reloading.
payloadNotes: Both DCS versions have a 50 kg warhead containing 25 kg of explosive and a 25 kg armor-piercing component. The complete drone weighs 370 kg and has a maximum speed of Mach 0.50.

paragraphs: Iran unveiled the Shahed-238 in 2023. It developed from the propeller-driven Shahed-136, keeping its delta-wing shape but replacing the propeller engine with a small turbojet for greater speed.
Several guidance versions have been shown. A related jet-powered version used by Russia is called Geran-3.

items: Fixed IR-seeking air-to-air missiles being unable to track the drone.
Fixed cannon and gun rounds passing through the drone.

t34-calliope.summary: A Sherman-mounted, 60-tube rocket launcher with custom M8 rockets, working machine guns and Combined Arms control.
facts: Troop concentrations, soft vehicles and area targets
notes: Copy T34 Calliope into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/ and restart DCS. Find TPG T34 Calliope (M4 Sherman) under Artillery. It is available to all countries and coalitions.
The Calliope fires automatically at enemies it can detect within range when ROE and Alarm State allow it. Keep its line of sight clear. Stop to fire rockets; the machine guns can fire while moving.

To drive and fire it yourself, enable Combined Arms vehicle control in the mission. With the default bindings, Q selects the main turret, E cycles its weapons and Space fires. The main cannon is disabled in this launcher-fitted version.

The 60 launch tubes fire in sequence, using custom M8 rockets. Rockets roll slowly in flight and spread across the target area, with more scatter from side to side. The rocket sight uses DCS’s MLRS range controls.
The coaxial and bow M1919 machine guns have separate ammunition supplies and 250-round belts, with custom firing sounds.
The launcher linkage, wiring, tracks, wheels and suspension are animated. The model has dim amber headlights, worn paint and dirt around the running gear.

The engine, running gear, weapons and hull have separate thermal maps for infrared views. Armor is modeled in 32 zones, including the extra plates visible on the hull. Lower-detail models are used at a distance for the tank, wreck and rockets.
The destroyed tank has an exposed radial engine, bent gun barrel, broken track, scattered rocket tubes and torn steel, with scorched surfaces and impact damage.
Original model by OK3D; DCS integration and custom materials by TPG. The download includes an installation and feature guide.

detailGallery.caption: Research reference: OS 9-69, Rockets and Launchers, February 1944

payloadNotes: Each 4.5-inch M8 rocket weighs about 17.28 kg and carries 4.3 lb (1.95 kg) of TNT in a high-explosive fragmentation warhead. A full salvo fires 60 rockets across an area. The coaxial and bow M1919 machine guns use separate supplies of .30-06 ball and tracer rounds.

paragraphs: The U.S. Army fitted the T34 Calliope launcher to M4 Sherman tanks during the Second World War. Its 60 tubes fired 4.5-inch M8 rockets in quick succession to bombard an area.

Tank-mounted rocket launchers were entering wider production by 1944. On the original Calliope, a linkage to the Sherman’s gun barrel raised and lowered the rocket rack. That linkage is animated in this mod.

references.label: U.S. Army: wartime tank-mounted rocket launchers

items: Adjusted rocket spread to better reflect the M8’s historical inaccuracy.
The Calliope now fires automatically at enemies it can detect within range.
Rebuilt the wreck with an exposed radial engine, bent barrel, broken track, scattered launcher tubes and torn metal.
Added scorched wreck textures and impact damage, and updated the destroyed-model images.
